title: Division as sharing out equally
examples: How do I share 12 sweets between 3 friends?

explain.say: Mei has 12 dumplings to share with her 2 cousins, so 3 people in all. How can it be fair? Look at the board: the 12 dumplings are dealt into 3 groups, and each person gets 4.
Share like dealing cards. Give one to each plate in turn: one, one, one. That is 3 dumplings gone, with 1 on each plate. Is it fair so far?
Keep going, round and round. After 6 dumplings, each of the 3 plates has 2. Every share is the same, and that is what fair shares means. How many dumplings are still left?
When all 12 are shared, each plate has 4. So 12 shared between 3 is 4. We write 12 divided by 3 equals 4. Can you check by counting one plate?
Brilliant! If a 4th friend comes, the same 12 share into 4 plates of 3. More people means smaller shares! Wow: division undoes multiplication, because 4 times 3 is 12. What is 12 shared between 2?

faq.a: Division means splitting a number into equal parts. Sharing 12 sweets equally between 3 friends is division: each gets 4.

faq.q: How do I share 12 sweets between 3 friends?
faq.a: Deal them out one at a time, like cards, to each friend in turn, until none are left. Each friend ends up with 4.
It means divided by, or shared equally between. 12 divided by 3 equals 4 means 12 shared between 3 gives 4 each.

faq.q: Why do more people get smaller shares?
faq.a: The total stays the same, so splitting it into more parts makes each part smaller. 12 between 3 is 4 each, but 12 between 4 is only 3 each.
asks: What happens if more friends come?

faq.q: How are multiplication and division linked?
faq.a: They undo each other. 3 groups of 4 is 12, so 12 shared into 3 groups is 4. One fact gives you the other.
asks: Is division the opposite of multiplying?

facts: Division is the inverse of multiplication: each one undoes the other.

quiz.say: 15 pencils are shared equally between 5 children. How many does each get?

wrong.1: 20 adds the numbers instead of dividing.

quiz.say: Which means the same as 12 divided by 4?
quiz.why: 12 ÷ 4 means 12 shared equally between 4, giving 3 each.

wrong.1: 12 groups of 4 is multiplying, which makes 48.
wrong.2: That is the wrong way round: here 4 is being shared, not 12.
